reason: A DSH plugin that alerts users with configurable audio when a root agent task completes, including background-tab playback, preset or imported sounds, volume control, and persisted preferences.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中，任务完成提示音会在根智能体回合结束时播放可配置的提示音，并支持预设或导入音频、音量调节和静音。
summaries.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin that plays a configurable sound when a root agent turn finishes, with preset or imported audio, volume control, mute, and persisted preferences.

capabilities: listens for root agent completion status
plays notification audio in the web GUI
persists volume, mute, and sound preferences
serves local plugin endpoints and polls task status
